representative_normalized: indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase saṃjagmāno abibhyuṣā mandū
ṣad apa cucyavat sa hi sthiro
ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadhasthāt agne
phenena namuceḥ śira indrodavartayaḥ viśvā yadajaya
bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatām ud asthāt
asya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasā
ā yāhi suṣumā hi ta indra
ud uttamaṃ varuṇa pāśam asmad avādhamaṃ
skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ
asi mahnā devānām asuryaḥ purohito vibhu jyotir
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo
nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu
